entities.name: Edinson Edgardo Farfán Córdova
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edinson Edgardo Farfán Córdova is a Peruvian Catholic prelate who has served as Bishop of Chiclayo since 2024, succeeding Robert Prevost. A member of the Order of Saint Augustine (OSA), he served simultaneously as parish priest, academic teacher, and administrator of the Order in several locations throughout Bolivia and Peru.
